verdict.rationale: treg documents a large hosted catalog reachable through one base URL and token: 159 documented operations plus proxying to 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints. The catalog is searchable by task, compares platforms side by side, and gives each endpoint its price, parameters and an example response. The named providers span SEO, enrichment, social, media generation and voice. Missing for 10: an explicit count of distinct third-party apps or providers (the 3,800+ figure counts endpoints, not integrations), and independent hands-on corroboration of catalog breadth beyond a commenter noting it 'supports many free tools'.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform

citations.quote: proxy a real request to any of 3,800+ catalogued provider endpoints through `/call/`
Search by what you want to _do_, not by vendor: `GET /catalog/search?q=backlinks`.
Every catalogued endpoint carries its price, parameters and an example response.
